extra.final_summary: The data had several issues affecting the total body mass calculation: (1) One row had 'Bisco' in the 'island' column, which was a misspelling of 'Biscoe' and was corrected using normalize_labels; (2) The 'body_mass_g' column was stored as text with commas (e.g., '2,900'), which was converted to numeric using cast_numeric; (3) Two exact duplicate rows were removed using drop_duplicates to prevent double-counting; (4) Three rows had body mass values (3,900,000g, 5,350,000g, 3,725,000g) that were far outside the valid range of 2,500–6,500g and were excluded as likely data entry errors. After these fixes, the total body mass for each species was calculated: Adelie: 82,550g, Chinstrap: 30,625g, Gentoo: 54,125g.
